news.title: The Fed’s Biggest Dove Sees No Clear Path Back to 2% Inflation
news.summary: When even a policymaker known for patience starts sounding alarmed, bond buyers lose a key ally. Goolsbee's warning raises a harder question for anyone holding long Treasuries: what happens if the Fed's last dove stops defending them?
news.title_zh: 聯準會最大鴿派人物看不出回歸 2% 通膨的明確路徑
news.summary_zh: 當連以耐心著稱的決策者開始發出警訊時，債券買家就失去了一位關鍵盟友。古爾斯比的警告對持有長期公債的任何人提出了更棘手的問題：如果聯準會最後一位鴿派人物停止為它們護航，會發生什麼？

news.title: Chart Of The Day: A Tale Of Two 'Safe Havens'
news.summary: The stock market is sliding. Tech stocks are getting tossed out. And investors are seeking safe havens. Two typical refuges in times of market turmoil are behaving differently - GLD and TLT.
news.title_zh: 每日圖表：兩大「避風港」的故事
news.summary_zh: 股市下滑。科技股被拋售。投資人尋求避風港。市場動盪時的兩大典型避難所——GLD 和 TLT——表現截然不同。

news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.title: A Monthly Check at 3 Levels of Risk: VTEB, TLT and EMB, Ranked
news.summary: A retiree's monthly bond fund check can stay steady while the share price behind it quietly collapses. Ranking three popular payers on both risks produces two lists that point in opposite directions, and one fund flips from safe to scary.
news.title_zh: 在 3 風險層級的每月檢視：VTEB、TLT 與 EMB 排名
news.summary_zh: 退休族的每月債券基金檢視可能看似穩定，但背後的股價卻悄悄崩塌。根據兩種風險對三檔熱門配息基金排名，產生兩份方向相反的名單，且有一檔基金從安全變得驚悚。

news.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
news.summary: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.
news.title_zh: 部分聯準會官員想在十月升息。半碼升息在考慮範圍內。
news.summary_zh: 聯準會會議記錄揭示鷹派陣營比十月投票顯示的更大，Waller 總裁表示央行可能需要震懾市場。長債持有者現在面臨岔路，一條路能救他們，另一條則持續擠壓。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%
news.summary_zh: 十二月升息看起來鐵定會發生，但對長期債券持有者最重要的國債市場卻回應不同的訊號。聯準會官員對這輪循環能走多遠意見分歧，TLT 持有者可能正在關注錯誤的數字。

news.title: The Government Spends About $5.5 Billion a Day More Than It Takes In. The Debt Has Doubled in 10 Years. Jaime Dimon This the Situation Could Get Much Worse.
news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.
news.title_zh: Bessent 告訴聯準會不要加息「太多」
news.summary_zh: 財政部希望聯準會緩手，而實際投票決定利率的官員則傾向相反方向。長期債券持有者處於這場對峙的中間，而十二月的兩個日期可能決定誰獲勝。

news.title: Kevin Warsh’s Fed Will Vote on Rates Only 7 Times in 2027
news.summary: The Fed is quietly trimming its meeting calendar, and long-term Treasuries already flinched. With a hike looming in December, fewer decision days could make every surprise hit bond holders harder. Which corner of the bond market gets hurt most?
news.title_zh: Kevin Warsh 的聯準會將僅在 2027 對利率投票 7 Times 次
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正悄悄縮減其會議行程，長期公債已有所反應。隨著十二月即將加息，較少的決策日可能使每個驚喜對債券持有者的衝擊更大。債券市場的哪個角落受損最重？

news.title: TSMC Tightens Restrictions on Chinese AI Chip Production Following New US Export Rules
news.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (NYSE:TSM) is introducing stricter manufacturing restrictions for Chinese semiconductor designers following changes to US export regulations, potentially limiting China’s ability to develop advanced artificial intelligence processors. According to Reuters, citing two people familiar with the matter, TSMC has suspended certain advanced chip manufacturing orders previously permitted under US regulations and is restricting affected Chinese customers to old

news.summary_zh: 台灣積體電路製造公司 (NYSE:TSM) 因應美國出口法規變更，對中國半導體設計公司實施更嚴格的製造限制，可能限制中國開發先進人工智慧處理器的能力。據路透社引述兩名知情人士透露，台積電已暫停先前在美國法規下獲准的某些先進晶片製造訂單，並限制受影響的中國客戶使用舊

news.title: Taiwan Stock Market Falls 6.2% to Cap Its Worst Week Since 1991 as KOSPI Closes Down 5.2% and Nikkei 225 Drops 5.1% in AI Chip Selloff
news.summary: Taiwan's stock market fell 6.2% on Friday to cap its worst week since 1991. The KOSPI closed down 5.2% and the Nikkei 225 dropped 5.1% in the AI chip selloff. Here are the closing numbers, the biggest stock moves and what they set up for Europe and Wall Street.

news.title_zh: 日經 225 下跌 4.5% 軟銀重挫 15% 華爾街AI拋售潮蔓延亞洲 股市恐創自 2020 以來最慘一週

news.title: Jensen Huang’s New Reality in Return as Nvidia CEO
news.summary: Jensen Huang’s reinstatement atop Nvidia comes with heightened scrutiny from multiple government institutions, not only for Huang, but for the company’s policies and corporate governance. Ed Ludlow reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳回任 Nvidia CEO 面臨的新現實
news.summary_zh: 黃仁勳重掌 Nvidia 帥印，伴隨著多個政府機構的嚴格審視，不僅針對黃仁勳本人，也針對公司的政策和公司治理。Ed Ludlow 於彭博電視報導。（來源：彭博）

news.title: IREN Fell 42% This Month Even After The Market Jump on NVIDIA News: This Wall Street Pro Maintains That 440% Returns Are Coming After Q3 Earnings Downgrades
news.summary: A delayed billion-dollar milestone, a funding gap and a bruising month have analysts slashing targets yet still cheering. One date on the calendar will show whether IREN's demand story outruns its financing problem.

news.summary_zh: 延遲的十億美元里程碑、資金缺口和慘烈的一個月，導致分析師大幅下調目標價卻仍看好。行事曆上的某個日期將顯示 IREN 的需求故事能否超越其融資問題。

news.title: Nvidia Added $954 Billion In A Day. Is Jensen Huang Too Big To Fire?
news.summary: After the 2008 financial crisis, Washington decided that some banks were too big to fail. Between Nov 12 and Nov 23, the White House showed it holds the same view about at least one person. He is Jensen Huang, the co-founder and chief executive of Nvidia.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 一天增加 $954 Billion。黃仁勳大到不能開除嗎？
news.summary_zh: 在 2008 金融危機後，華盛頓決定有些銀行大到不能倒。在 Nov 12 和 Nov 23 之間，白宮顯示它對至少一個人持有相同觀點。他是黃仁勳，Nvidia 的共同創辦人兼執行長。

news.title: How Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia made the world trillions richer
news.summary: Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO made him about $34 billion (€31bn) richer and added roughly $950 billion (€871bn) to the chipmaker's value in a single day. US President Donald Trump, Nvidia's staff and stock markets from New York to Seoul gained too, while Europe got a smaller lift.View on euronews
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳重返 Nvidia 如何讓全球增加數兆財富
news.summary_zh: 黃仁勳以 Nvidia CEO 身分回歸，讓他個人增加約 $34 billion (€31bn)，並在一天內為這家晶片製造商增加約 $950 billion (€871bn) 的價值。美國總統唐納·川普、Nvidia 員工以及從紐約到首爾的股市也都獲利，歐洲則獲得較小幅度提升。View on euronews

news.title: Nvidia Shares Fall 5% in Premarket Trading as Goldman Sachs Highlights Lingering Uncertainty Following Huang’s Return
news.summary: Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) shares fell approximately 5% in premarket trading on Tuesday as investors reassessed the semiconductor company’s outlook following the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president and chief executive officer. At 10:49 GMT, the stock was trading lower after gaining 31.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 股價盤前下跌 5%，高盛強調黃仁勳回歸後的持續不確定性
news.summary_zh: Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) 股價在週二盤前交易中下跌約 5%，投資人在黃仁勳恢復總裁兼執行長職位後重新評估這家半導體公司的前景。在 10:49 GMT，股價下跌交易，此前曾上漲 31。

news.title: Most Of Nvidia's Drop Came Before Huang Left
news.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday, Nov 23. He had resigned after the board opened an investigation into reports that he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The stock rose 31.5% that day and closed at $165.05. U.S. stocks rose with it. Even so, Nvidia still sits 31.0% below its Oct 6 record close of $239.24.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 大部分跌幅發生在黃仁勳離開前
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 董事會在週一恢復黃仁勳 CEO 職位，Nov 23。他在董事會展開調查、針對他是外國情報行動目標的報導後辭職。當天股價上漲 31.5%，收盤價為 $165.05。美股隨之上漲。即便如此，Nvidia 仍比其 Oct 6 歷史收盤高點 $239.24 低 31.0%。

news.title: CrowdStrike Shares Fall 10% After a $44 Billion Zscaler Deal Despite an Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., explains why shares of CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) fell about 10% on Monday, November 23, while most tech stocks rallied. The trigger was a proposed acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) for about $44 billion, announced the same morning. The sell-off came despite a strong report. CrowdStrike posted revenue growth of 28.3% against expectations of 23.9%, and EPS of $0.34 against $0.31. It also raised full-year guidance. Bleeker points to the deal instead: Zscaler's wide product line may be hard to integrate into CrowdStrike's platform, and the roughly 34% premium arrives when cybersecurity stocks are richly valued. Zscaler shares rose about 16%, while CrowdStrike is now down 26% from its recent highs. Bleeker lays out both cases. The bull case is that cybersecurity budgets must rise as companies patch systems, with outages at Apple and others as examples. The bear case is that frontier AI models may become the center of cyber defense, which raises questions about what companies like CrowdStrike offer. Expect choppy trading in these shares while investors sort that out.
news.title_zh: CrowdStrike 股價下跌 10%，儘管盈餘超預期並上調指引，但因 $44 Billion Zscaler 交易
news.summary_zh: Eric Bleeker，24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長，解釋為何 CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) 股價於週一 November 23 下跌約 10%，而大多數科技股上漲。觸發原因是當天早上宣布擬以約 $44 billion 收購 Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS)。儘管財報強勁，仍出現拋售。CrowdStrike 營收成長 28.3%，優於預期的 23.9%，每股盈餘 $0.34，優於 $0.31。公司也上調全年指引。Bleeker 指出交易才是關鍵：Zscaler 寬廣的產品線可能難以整合進 CrowdStrike 平台，且約 34% 的溢價正值網安股估值高檔時。Zscaler 股價上漲約 16%，而 CrowdStrike 目前較近期高點下跌 26%。Bleeker 闡述多空雙方觀點。多頭理由：企業修補系統，網安預算必增，Apple 等停機事件為例。空頭理由：前沿 AI 模型可能成為網防核心，質疑 CrowdStrike 等公司價值。預期這些股票將震盪交易，直到投資人理清方向。

news.title: Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDA. Why Apple, Broadcom, and Anthropic Could Be Under Pressure
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer of 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return as CEO of NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) sent stocks sharply higher on Monday morning. NVIDIA shares opened up 34% at about $170, restoring more than $1 trillion of value to shareholders. The NASDAQ rose about 6.75% and the S&P 500 about 4.6%, erasing much of Friday's sell-off. Bleeker focuses on stocks lagging a market where nearly everything is up. Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) gained only about 1.7%, and he says a rotation back into AI-adjacent names could pull capital out of the safe-haven stock. Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) rose about 6% at the open, trailing the NASDAQ and semiconductor indexes. It fell about 12% Friday on reports that Google was cutting some of its TPU allocation. Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANT) also rose 6%, but its shares have been under pressure since Thursday's IPO, and NVIDIA's backing of open-weight models is a competitive threat. CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) fell about 5% at the open, partly on its $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS). Bleeker notes that money that moved into cybersecurity as semiconductors sold off could rotate back. He says to watch for competitive pressure on these names in the coming weeks.
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA。為何蘋果、博通和 Anthropic 可能面臨壓力
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 指出，黃仁勳以 NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) 執行長身分回歸，讓股價週一早盤大幅上漲。NVIDIA 股價開盤上漲 34% 至約 $170，為股東恢復逾 $1 trillion 價值。納斯達克上漲約 6.75%，標普 500 上漲約 4.6%，抹平週五大部分跌幅。Bleeker 關注在幾乎全盤上漲的市場中落後的股票。蘋果 (NASDAQ: AAPL) 僅上漲約 1.7%，他表示資金輪回至 AI 相關股票可能會從避風港股票抽離資金。博通 (NASDAQ: AVGO) 開盤上漲約 6%，落後於納斯達克和半導體指數。週五因傳聞谷歌削減部分 TPU 配置而下跌約 12%。Anthropic (NASDAQ: ANT) 也上漲 6%，但其股價自週四 IPO 以來承壓，且 NVIDIA 支持開放權重模型構成競爭威脅。CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) 開盤下跌約 5%，部分原因是其 $44 billion 收購 Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS)。Bleeker 指出，隨著半導體遭拋售而流入網安的資金可能輪回。他建議未來幾週關注這些股票的競爭壓力。

news.title: Elon Musk Reportedly Told Staff SpaceX Is Falling Behind in AI
news.summary: Musk's own yardstick for AI success is revenue per GPU, and by that measure SpaceX's smartest move may be helping its rivals win. The catch is a short exit clause that could unravel the whole bet.
news.title_zh: 據報 Elon Musk 告訴員工 SpaceX 在 AI 領域落後
news.summary_zh: Musk 衡量 AI 成功的標準是每 GPU 營收，按此衡量，SpaceX 最聰明的舉動可能是幫助競爭對手獲勝。關鍵在於一個短期退出條款，可能會讓整筆押注落空。

news.title: Musk Targets Starlink in All Tesla Models “Towards the End of Next Year.” China Is the Catch
news.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk said he hopes a built-in Starlink option reaches all Tesla models toward the end of 2027, except in China, where he says Starlink is illegal. The connection matters most for Tesla’s robotaxis, and Tesla would buy it from SpaceX, which runs Starlink.
news.title_zh: 馬斯克鎖定在所有特斯拉車型中加入 Starlink「明年年底前」。中國是變數
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要馬斯克表示，他希望內建 Starlink 選項能在 2027 年底前覆蓋所有特斯拉車型，中國除外，他稱 Starlink 在中國屬非法。這項連線對特斯拉 Robotaxi 最為關鍵，特斯拉將向經營 Starlink 的 SpaceX 採購。

news.title: Anthropic Backer Dismisses Musk as “a Glorified Compute Reseller.” Here’s What Reselling Earns SpaceX
news.summary: Key TakeawaysEarly Anthropic investor Anjney Midha called Elon Musk “a glorified compute reseller” on a recent 20VC episode, as SpaceX shares rose 4. 35% on Monday after a Jefferies Buy rating.
news.title_zh: Anthropic 支持者稱 Musk 為「光榮的算力轉售商」。這是轉售為 SpaceX 帶來的收益
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點早期 Anthropic 投資人 Anjney Midha 在最近的 20VC 節目中稱 Elon Musk 為「光榮的算力轉售商」，當時 SpaceX 股價上漲 4。在 Jefferies 給予買入評級後，週一 35%。

news.title: SpaceX and Tesla Directors Hold Talks Over Potential US$3.5 Trillion Merger
news.summary: Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX) and Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA) are exploring a potential US$3. 5 trillion merger, with five directors appointed to negotiate the terms of a proposed all-stock transaction, according to a report by the Financial Times on Tuesday.
news.title_zh: SpaceX 與 Tesla 董事就潛在 US$3.5 Trillion 合併進行會談
news.summary_zh: 據《金融時報》週二報導，Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX) 與 Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA) 正在探討潛在的 US$3。5 trillion 合併，並指派五位董事協商擬議全股票交易的條款。

news.title: Jim Chanos: A Tesla Deal Would “Cut SpaceX’s Growth Rate by Over 60%.” Bad News for SpaceX Holders
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJim Chanos says a Tesla merger would cut SpaceX’s growth rate by over 60% and its 2027 EPS by almost 40%. Analysts’ estimates back him on growth: SpaceX alone is expected to grow revenue about 272% in 2027, against about 94% combined with Tesla.
news.title_zh: Jim Chanos：特斯拉交易將「削減 SpaceX 增長率超過 60%。」對 SpaceX 持有者來說是壞消息
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Jim Chanos 表示，特斯拉合併將使 SpaceX 增長率削減超過 60%，其 2027 每股盈餘 (EPS) 削減近 40%。分析師估計支持其增長觀點：SpaceX 單獨預計在 2027 營收增長約 272%，而與特斯拉合併後約為 94%。

news.title: Musk Asks “Who Wouldn’t Want to Hire Jensen?” as Wall Street Floats SpaceX for His Next Move
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia’s (NVDA:NASDAQ) board says Jensen Huang won’t return as CEO, and Wall Street is already floating SpaceX (SPCX:NASDAQ) and Intel (INTC:NASDAQ) as his next stop. Huang’s decades of supplier relationships, including with Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM:NYSE), were part of Nvidia’s edge, and any slip in that edge helps AMD (AMD:NASDAQ).
news.title_zh: Musk 問「誰不想雇用 Jensen？」華爾街推測 SpaceX 為他下一步動向
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Nvidia (NVDA:NASDAQ) 董事會表示 Jensen Huang 不會回任 CEO，華爾街已推測 SpaceX (SPCX:NASDAQ) 和 Intel (INTC:NASDAQ) 為他下一站。Huang 數十年的供應商關係，包括與 Taiwan Semiconductor (TSM:NYSE)，是 Nvidia 優勢的一部分，該優勢任何動搖都有助於 AMD (AMD:NASDAQ)。

news.title: Tesla And SpaceX Reportedly Name 5 Directors To Lead Merger Discussions — Investor Says Talks Are Moving At ‘Warp Speed’
news.summary: After Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, New Street’s Pierre Ferragu called a Tesla-SpaceX merger the “next move.”
news.title_zh: 特斯拉和SpaceX據報任命 5 位董事主導合併談判 — 投資人稱談判以「曲速」推進
news.summary_zh: 在輝達重新任命黃仁勳後，New Street的Pierre Ferragu稱特斯拉-SpaceX合併為「下一步驟」。

news.title: Could SpaceX Actually Climb 57%? Or Is Jefferies Totally Wrong?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJefferies initiated coverage of SpaceX with a Buy rating and a $210 target, 57% above a stock that sits 34% below its June closing high. The target asks for a lower multiple than SpaceX trades at today, so the upside depends on earnings roughly doubling by 2028.
news.title_zh: SpaceX真的能攀升至 57% 嗎？還是Jefferies完全錯了？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Jefferies 開始覆蓋 SpaceX，給予買入評級和 $210 目標價，較股價高 57%，而股價較六月收盤高點低 34%。該目標價要求的倍數低於 SpaceX 目前的交易倍數，因此上漲空間取決於盈利約在 2028 前翻倍。

news.title: Not Starlink. Not Starship. This SpaceX Business Could Be Worth $80 Billion on Its Own.
news.summary: Space Exploration Technologies' fastest-growing business doesn't fly, orbit, or beam internet, and it might be worth $80 billion on its own.
news.title_zh: 不是Starlink。不是Starship。這項SpaceX業務本身可能值 $80 Billion。
news.summary_zh: Space Exploration Technologies增長最快的業務不飛行、不環軌、不發射網路，但它本身可能值 $80 billion。

news.title: SpaceX Stock Is Down 39% From Its High. Here's What Has to Happen Before I'd Buy.

news.summary_zh: SpaceX業務蓬勃發展 — — 但在我的標準裡，它成為買進對象前還得發生些什麼。

news.title: TSLA And SPCX Rally As Musk Cheers Huang’s Return — Analyst Flags Nvidia’s Push To Send SpaceX More Chips
news.summary: ARK’s Brett Winton believes Huang ultimately favored directing additional chip supply toward SpaceX rather than financing a broader group of smaller AI infrastructure developers still struggling to bring their projects online.
news.title_zh: TSLA和SPCX因馬斯克歡呼黃仁勳回歸而上漲 — 分析師指出輝達推動向SpaceX供應更多晶片
news.summary_zh: ARK的Brett Winton認為，黃仁勳最終傾向於將額外晶片供應導向SpaceX，而非資助一大群仍在努力讓專案上線的較小型AI基礎設施開發商。

news.title: Cathie Wood Swapped Nvidia for SpaceX Over the Risk of “Losing Jensen.” Now Jensen’s Back
news.summary: ARK dumped Nvidia because one man might walk away to join Elon Musk. Then the board did the unthinkable, and the trade started to look very different. What did Wood's bet miss, and what risks still hang over Nvidia holders?

news.summary_zh: ARK拋售輝達，因為一個人可能離開去加入馬斯克。然後董事會做出了不可思議的事，交易開始看起來大不相同。Wood的押注錯在哪？輝達持有者仍面臨什麼風險？

news.title: Semiconductor Stocks like Micron, Marvell, and Bloom Energy See Massive Gains as Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDIA
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., covers the news that Jensen Huang is returning to NVIDIA, announced shortly before Monday's open. Shares of NVIDIA are up 31%. The Nasdaq (Nasdaq: QQQ) is up about 5.7%, the S&P 500 about 4% and the Dow Jones 2.1%. The VanEck semiconductor ETF (Nasdaq: SMH) is up 13%. Bleeker names three stocks with the most to gain outside NVIDIA. Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) fell hard after big gains at the start of 2026, and Huang himself has said it could be the next trillion dollar company. It's rising along with the broader optics group after its recent move for Lumentum. Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) is up 14%, recovering Friday's losses, and Huang's return supports confidence in ecosystems like NeoClouds. Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) is up 19% in a broad rebound of behind-the-meter power stocks that the elections had beaten down. Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) and many hyperscalers, which could have gained from losing a key rival, are seeing much more muted moves. Many of these stocks are up 15% or 20% but are mostly replacing losses from Friday and sometimes Thursday. Rising rates and the midterm elections remain as overhangs, and many chip stocks sit more than 50% below recent highs. Bleeker's question is whether this becomes an enduring rally.

news.title: Semiconductor Stocks like Micron, Marvell, and Bloom Energy See Massive Gains as Jensen Huang Returns to NVIDIA
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., covers the news that Jensen Huang is returning to NVIDIA, announced shortly before Monday's open. Shares of NVIDIA are up 31%. The Nasdaq (Nasdaq: QQQ) is up about 5.7%, the S&P 500 about 4% and the Dow Jones 2.1%. The VanEck semiconductor ETF (Nasdaq: SMH) is up 13%. Bleeker names three stocks with the most to gain outside NVIDIA. Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) fell hard after big gains at the start of 2026, and Huang himself has said it could be the next trillion dollar company. It's rising along with the broader optics group after its recent move for Lumentum. Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) is up 14%, recovering Friday's losses, and Huang's return supports confidence in ecosystems like NeoClouds. Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) is up 19% in a broad rebound of behind-the-meter power stocks that the elections had beaten down. Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) and many hyperscalers, which could have gained from losing a key rival, are seeing much more muted moves. Many of these stocks are up 15% or 20% but are mostly replacing losses from Friday and sometimes Thursday. Rising rates and the midterm elections remain as overhangs, and many chip stocks sit more than 50% below recent highs. Bleeker's question is whether this becomes an enduring rally.
news.title_zh: 隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，Micron、Marvell 和 Bloom Energy 等半導體股大漲
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 報導 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA 的消息，該消息在週一開盤前不久公布。NVIDIA 股價上漲 31%。納斯達克 (Nasdaq: QQQ) 上漲約 5.7%，標普 500 上漲約 4%，道瓊 2.1%。VanEck 半導體 ETF (Nasdaq: SMH) 上漲 13%。Bleeker 點出 NVIDIA 之外最有獲利潛力的三檔股票。Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) 在 2026 初大漲後重挫，Huang 本人曾說它可能成為下一家兆元公司。隨著其近期收購 Lumentum，該股隨光學族群上漲。Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) 上漲 14%，收復週五跌幅，Huang 重返支持對 NeoClouds 等生態系統的信心。Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) 上漲 19%，在用戶側電力股廣泛反彈中，這些股票此前因選舉而被打壓。Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) 和許多超大規模廠商，本可能從失去關鍵對手中獲利，卻只見溫和漲幅。許多這類股票上漲 15% 或 20%，但主要只是填補週五有時還有週四的跌幅。利率上升和期中選舉仍是壓頂因素，許多晶片股仍在近期高點下方逾 50%。Bleeker 的問題在於這是否會成為持久反彈。

news.title: Palantir Rips 10% to Lead Software Stocks. Cloudflare and ServiceNow Also Join ‘Jensen Rally’
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA is lifting technology stocks on Monday. The NASDAQ was up more than 7% as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern, after opening with a 3% pre-market gain following Friday's sell-off. Chip stocks as a group rose more than 13%. Software is also higher, but the gains are uneven. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) are each up about 3%, while the IGV software ETF is up 4%. The biggest winners are companies that benefit from sovereign AI and a strong open-weight ecosystem. Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) leads at 10%, and Palantir has been one of the loudest backers of sovereign AI. Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) is up roughly 7%, and ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is up 5%, helped by its control tower software that guides customers between models and agentic workloads. Anthropic is lagging, since Huang has pushed open-weight models that pressure leading labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. Bleeker's takeaway: if Huang keeps backing open weight model makers, Palantir, Cloudflare and ServiceNow, up 5% to 10%, should keep outperforming the 2% to 3% gains in the rest of software.
news.title_zh: Palantir 飆升 10% 領漲軟體股。Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 也加入「Jensen Rally」
news.summary_zh: 首席投資長 Eric Bleeker 在 24/7 華爾街表示，黃仁勳重返 NVIDIA 於週一帶動科技股上漲。納斯達克指數截至 1:30 下午 (東部時間) 上漲逾 7%，此前受週五拋售潮影響，盤前漲幅達 3%。晶片股群體上漲逾 13%。軟體股也上漲，但漲幅不均。微軟 (NASDAQ: MSFT) 和 Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) 各上漲約 3%，而 IGV 軟體 ETF 上漲 4%。最大贏家是受惠於主權 AI 和強大開放權重生態系的公司。Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) 領漲 10%，且 Palantir 一直是主權 AI 最響亮的支持者之一。Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) 上漲約 7%，ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) 上漲 5%，得益於其控制塔軟體引導客戶在模型和代理式工作負載之間切換。Anthropic 表現落後，因黃仁勳推動開放權重模型，對 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 等領先實驗室構成壓力。Bleeker 的結論：若黃仁勳持續支持開放權重模型製造商，Palantir、Cloudflare 和 ServiceNow 上漲 5% to 10%，應會持續優於軟體其餘部分 2% to 3% 的漲幅。

news.title: Nebius & CoreWeave Jump 21% While Oracle Sees 12% Gains on Monday Following Jensen’s Return
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says neocloud stocks rallied Monday on the return of Jensen Huang to NVIDIA. At 1:30 p.m. Eastern, Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) and CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) were each up 21%, IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) was up 25%, TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) was up 13% and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was up 12%. Leading ETFs showed software up closer to 4% and semiconductors up 13%. Bleeker also pointed to two company-specific items. The New York Times reported that Anthropic's demand is so large that SpaceX needs new data centers by October to fill its orders. On Friday, Oracle said it has secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract. Bleeker notes Nvidia helped build neoclouds with funding, technical expertise and chips. He calls it a one-day win. Nebius is down 38% over the past month, CoreWeave 12% and Oracle 10%. Over six months Nebius is down more than 50%, Oracle 40% and CoreWeave 55%. Bleeker names three drivers of the selloff: higher rates and wider credit default swaps, political worries after the midterms, and Huang's removal. Only the last has reversed. Going forward, watch the Fed's rate path and how politics affects project locations such as Texas.
news.title_zh: Nebius 與 CoreWeave 上漲 21%，而 Oracle 在 Jensen 回歸後於週一錄得 12% 漲幅
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資官 Eric Bleeker 表示，隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，新雲端股票週一反彈。美國東部時間 1:30 下午，Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) 和 CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) 各上漲 21%，IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) 上漲 25%，TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) 上漲 13%，Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) 上漲 12%。領先 ETF 顯示軟體上漲接近 4%，半導體上漲 13%。Bleeker 還指出了兩項公司特定事項。《紐約時報》報導，Anthropic 的需求龐大到 SpaceX 需要在十月前建立新數據中心以滿足訂單。週五，Oracle 表示已獲得其 OpenAI 合約所需的所有資金。Bleeker 指出 Nvidia 以資金、技術專長和晶片協助建立新雲端服務商。他稱這只是一日勝果。過去一個月 Nebius 下跌 38%，CoreWeave 12%，Oracle 10%。六個月來 Nebius 下跌超過 50%，Oracle 40%，CoreWeave 55%。Bleeker 指出拋售的三大驅動因素：利率上升和信用違約互換擴大、中期選舉後的政治擔憂，以及 Huang 的離職。只有最後一項已扭轉。展望未來，關注美聯儲利率路徑以及政治如何影響德州等項目地點。

news.title: Nebius & CoreWeave Jump 21% While Oracle Sees 12% Gains on Monday Following Jensen’s Return
news.summary: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says neocloud stocks rallied Monday on the return of Jensen Huang to NVIDIA. At 1:30 p.m. Eastern, Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) and CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) were each up 21%, IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) was up 25%, TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) was up 13% and Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) was up 12%. Leading ETFs showed software up closer to 4% and semiconductors up 13%. Bleeker also pointed to two company-specific items. The New York Times reported that Anthropic's demand is so large that SpaceX needs new data centers by October to fill its orders. On Friday, Oracle said it has secured all funding needed for its OpenAI contract. Bleeker notes Nvidia helped build neoclouds with funding, technical expertise and chips. He calls it a one-day win. Nebius is down 38% over the past month, CoreWeave 12% and Oracle 10%. Over six months Nebius is down more than 50%, Oracle 40% and CoreWeave 55%. Bleeker names three drivers of the selloff: higher rates and wider credit default swaps, political worries after the midterms, and Huang's removal. Only the last has reversed. Going forward, watch the Fed's rate path and how politics affects project locations such as Texas.
news.title_zh: Nebius 與 CoreWeave 上漲 21%，而 Oracle 在 Jensen 回歸後於週一錄得 12% 漲幅
news.summary_zh: 24/7 Wall St. 首席投資官 Eric Bleeker 表示，隨著 Jensen Huang 重返 NVIDIA，新雲端股票週一反彈。美國東部時間 1:30 下午，Nebius Group (NASDAQ: NBIS) 和 CoreWeave (NASDAQ: CRWV) 各上漲 21%，IREN (NASDAQ: IREN) 上漲 25%，TeraWulf (NASDAQ: WULF) 上漲 13%，Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) 上漲 12%。領先 ETF 顯示軟體上漲接近 4%，半導體上漲 13%。Bleeker 還指出了兩項公司特定事項。《紐約時報》報導，Anthropic 的需求龐大到 SpaceX 需要在十月前建立新數據中心以滿足訂單。週五，Oracle 表示已獲得其 OpenAI 合約所需的所有資金。Bleeker 指出 Nvidia 以資金、技術專長和晶片協助建立新雲端服務商。他稱這只是一日勝果。過去一個月 Nebius 下跌 38%，CoreWeave 12%，Oracle 10%。六個月來 Nebius 下跌超過 50%，Oracle 40%，CoreWeave 55%。Bleeker 指出拋售的三大驅動因素：利率上升和信用違約互換擴大、中期選舉後的政治擔憂，以及 Huang 的離職。只有最後一項已扭轉。展望未來，關注美聯儲利率路徑以及政治如何影響德州等項目地點。

news.title: Dell Wants Up to 45% More on Signed AI Deals. IREN Has a Big Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDell, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are asking for up to 45% more for AI servers already under contract, the Financial Times reported. IREN agreed to buy about $5.
news.title_zh: Dell 要求在已簽署 AI 交易上再漲價高達 45%。IREN 面臨大問題
news.summary_zh: 《金融時報》報導，Dell、HPE、Lenovo 和 Supermicro 要求為已簽約的 AI 伺服器再漲價高達 45%。IREN 同意購買約 $5。

news.title: Scott Galloway Says Neoclouds Are “Going to Default.” CoreWeave’s Interest Bill Is the Problem
news.summary: Key TakeawaysScott Galloway predicts neocloud defaults and bankruptcies, naming CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN after a brutal week for all three. CoreWeave’s third-quarter interest expense of $846 million was about 4x its operating income, and it’s still rising.
news.title_zh: Scott Galloway 稱新雲端服務商「將違約」。CoreWeave 的利息支出是問題所在
news.summary_zh: Scott Galloway 在三家公司經歷慘烈一週後預測新雲端服務商將違約和破產，點名 CoreWeave、Nebius 和 IREN。CoreWeave 第三季利息支出達 $846 million，約為其營業收入的 4x，且仍在上升。

news.title: Bad News for CoreWeave and IREN: GPU Lenders Now Want “50 to 60 Percent” Loan-to-Value, Down From 80%
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGPU lenders now want 50% to 60% loan-to-value, down from 80% over the summer, according to Odd Lots guest Stanley Lee. At those levels, a neocloud has to cover 40% to 50% of each chip itself, up from 20%.
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 和 IREN 的壞消息：GPU 放款方現在要求「50 to 60 Percent」貸款價值比，低於 80%
news.summary_zh: 據 Odd Lots 嘉賓 Stanley Lee 指出，GPU 放款方現在要求 50% to 60% 貸款價值比，低於夏季的 80%。在這些水平下，新雲端服務商必須自行承擔每顆晶片的 40% to 50%，高於之前的 20%。

news.title: IREN Soars 25%, Nebius Up 22% as Neoclouds Rebound After Brutal Week
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN rose 25% today as AI stocks bounced back from the Nasdaq’s worst week since 2020. IREN had no news and led last week’s neocloud selloff with a 36% drop.
news.title_zh: IREN 飆漲 25%，Nebius 上漲 22%，新雲端服務商在慘烈一週後反彈
news.summary_zh: IREN 今日上漲 25%，AI 股票從自 2020 以來 Nasdaq 最慘烈的一週中反彈。IREN 沒有消息面支撐，卻以 36% 跌幅領跌上週新雲端服務商拋售潮。

news.title: Nebius Rallies 30% Despite New U.S. Curbs Threatening Neocloud Business in Southeast Asia; IREN Jumps 24%, CoreWeave Climbs 7%
news.summary: Investors are bidding up AI cloud stocks while Washington targets the rental loophole Chinese firms use to reach Nvidia chips. Only one of three neocloud players has a direct foothold in the affected region, and a February deadline looms.
news.title_zh: Nebius 反彈 30% 儘管新的美國限制威脅東南亞 Neocloud 業務；IREN 飆升 24%，CoreWeave 上漲 7%
news.summary_zh: 投資人正在推高 AI 雲端股票，而華盛頓鎖定中國企業用來獲取 Nvidia 晶片的租賃漏洞。三家 neocloud 參與者中僅有一家在受影響地區擁有直接立足點，且二月截止日期迫在眉睫。

news.title: Gavin Baker Says “Consolidation Is Probably Coming” for Neoclouds That Can’t Get Prepayments. Here’s Who Can
news.summary: Key TakeawaysGavin Baker says consolidation is probably coming for neoclouds that can’t win customer prepayments and rely entirely on private credit. CoreWeave and IREN are clearly winning prepayments, Nebius likely is too, and Microsoft is prepaying 20% of IREN’s contract.
news.title_zh: Gavin Baker 說「整合很可能到來」針對無法獲得預付款的 Neoclouds。這裡是誰能做到
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Gavin Baker 指出，無法贏得客戶預付款且完全依賴私人信貸的 neoclouds 很可能面臨整合。CoreWeave 和 IREN 明顯贏得預付款，Nebius 也很可能，而 Microsoft 正預付 IREN 合約的 20%。

news.title: CRWV, IREN, NBIS Rally After Sell-Off — New US Curbs Threaten Southeast Asia Neocloud Business
news.summary: The trio lost over a quarter of their value last week.
news.title_zh: CRWV、IREN、NBIS 於拋售後反彈 — 新的美國限制威脅東南亞 Neocloud 業務
news.summary_zh: 這三檔股票上週損失超過四分之一的價值。

news.title: Warning for CoreWeave: Satya Nadella Says “Selling to One or Two Customers Is Not a Business”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft CEO Satya Nadella said selling to one or two customers “is not a business,” and that Microsoft builds its own capacity first and rents last. That’s a warning for CoreWeave, whose three biggest customers made up 72% of second-quarter revenue, and for Nebius and IREN, which count Microsoft as an anchor customer.
news.title_zh: 對 CoreWeave 的警告：Satya Nadella 說「只賣給一兩個客戶不是生意」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella 表示，只賣給一兩個客戶「不是生意」，且 Microsoft 先建設自有產能、最後才出租。這對 CoreWeave 是個警告，其前三大客戶佔第二季營收的 72%，對於以 Microsoft 為錨定客戶的 Nebius 和 IREN 也是如此。

news.title: Riot Platforms Just Gained 18% in a Month on a $28 Billion AI Lease. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysRiot Platforms rose 18% in a month on a $28 billion lease to Anthropic. Riot’s tenant buys the computers, so unlike IREN, Riot builds at about half the usual cost and doesn’t currently expect to sell stock.
news.title_zh: Riot Platforms 一月漲幅 18%，憑藉 $28 Billion AI 租約。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Riot Platforms 一個月上漲 18%，憑藉 $28 billion 租約給 Anthropic。Riot 的租戶購買電腦，所以不同於 IREN，Riot 建設成本約為一般的一半，且目前不預期出售股票。

news.title: Between IREN and CoreWeave Here’s Who Has the Cleaner Path to a Sustained 30% Rebound
news.summary: Both AI cloud darlings tumbled after NVIDIA flashed a warning on financing, yet one sits on billions in customer prepayments while the other still hunts a $6B funding gap. Which stock can actually power a lasting comeback?
news.title_zh: 在 IREN 和 CoreWeave 之間，誰擁有更清晰的路徑實現持續的 30% 反彈
news.summary_zh: 在 NVIDIA 發出融資警告後，兩家 AI 雲端寵兒股價雙雙暴跌，但一家擁有數十億美元客戶預付款，另一家仍在尋覓 $6B 資金缺口。哪檔股票真能推動持久反彈？

news.title: Cipher Digital Sinks 5%, CoreWeave Down 7% as Anthropic’s Debut Fails to Stop AI Selloff
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCipher Digital fell 5% this morning with no company news, as the AI selloff outlasted Anthropic’s record Nasdaq debut. CoreWeave and IREN fell too, as the market sells AI data center stocks as one group.
news.title_zh: Cipher Digital 下跌 5%，CoreWeave 下跌 7%，因 Anthropic 首秀無法阻止 AI 拋售潮
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Cipher Digital 早盤下跌 5%，且無公司消息，因 AI 拋售潮持續時間超過 Anthropic 破紀錄的納斯達克首秀。CoreWeave 和 IREN 也下跌，因市場將 AI 資料中心股票作為一組進行拋售。
